name: WIC Partition Layout
blurb: a .wks kickstart and rootfs size for an SD card or eMMC, drawn to scale
intro: Lays out a wic .wks the way wic itself does (poky scarthgap scripts/lib/wic: ksparser units and defaults, the source plugins' size rules, direct.py placement) on a device of real size, with bitbake's ROOTFS_SIZE from image.bbclass. It flags overlaps, a raw bootloader pushed off its ROM offset, a rootfs larger than its --fixed-size, an image too big for the device and partitions off the erase-block grid.

inputs.label: Kickstart (.wks)
inputs.default:
# i.MX8M Mini eMMC: imx-boot raw at 33K (ROM offset), boot, A/B rootfs, data
# after meta-freescale imx-imx-boot-bootpart.wks.in
part u-boot --source rawcopy --sourceparams="file=imx-boot" --ondisk mmcblk2 --no-table --align 33
part /boot --source bootimg-partition --ondisk mmcblk2 --fstype=vfat --label boot --active --align 8192 --size 64
part / --source rootfs --ondisk mmcblk2 --fstype=ext4 --label rootfsA --align 8192 --fixed-size 1536
part --source rootfs --ondisk mmcblk2 --fstype=ext4 --label rootfsB --align 8192 --fixed-size 1536
part /data --ondisk mmcblk2 --fstype=ext4 --label data --align 8192 --size 512
bootloader --ptable msdos
inputs.help: part / bootloader lines as in a .wks or .wks.in (${...} left unexpanded is read as text).

inputs.label: Erase block / AU
inputs.help: eMMC erase group (often 512K) or SD allocation unit (often 4M).

inputs.label: Content sizes
inputs.help: Sizes wic takes from files: the rawcopy file, IMAGE_BOOT_FILES. Match by mount point, label, part-name or sourceparams file.

examples.title: i.MX8M Mini eMMC with A/B rootfs and a data partition

input.wks:
# i.MX8M Mini eMMC: imx-boot raw at 33K (ROM offset), boot, A/B rootfs, data
# after meta-freescale imx-imx-boot-bootpart.wks.in
part u-boot --source rawcopy --sourceparams="file=imx-boot" --ondisk mmcblk2 --no-table --align 33
part /boot --source bootimg-partition --ondisk mmcblk2 --fstype=vfat --label boot --active --align 8192 --size 64
part / --source rootfs --ondisk mmcblk2 --fstype=ext4 --label rootfsA --align 8192 --fixed-size 1536
part --source rootfs --ondisk mmcblk2 --fstype=ext4 --label rootfsB --align 8192 --fixed-size 1536
part /data --ondisk mmcblk2 --fstype=ext4 --label data --align 8192 --size 512
bootloader --ptable msdos

examples.title: Rockchip GPT eMMC with idbloader at 32K and u-boot.itb at 8M

input.wks:
# Rockchip eMMC: idbloader.img at sector 64 (32K), u-boot.itb at sector 16384 (8M)
part loader1 --part-name=loader1 --offset 32K --fixed-size 4000K --source rawcopy --sourceparams="file=idbloader.img"
part v_storage --part-name=v_storage --offset 4032K --fixed-size 32K
part loader2 --part-name=loader2 --offset 8M --fixed-size 4M --source rawcopy --sourceparams="file=u-boot.itb"
part /boot --part-name=boot --source bootimg-partition --fstype=vfat --label boot --active --align 16384 --size 64
part / --part-name=root --source rootfs --fstype=ext4 --label root --align 16384
bootloader --ptable gpt

usage: Give the .wks text (wks), a device preset or custom size, the erase block, the rootfs du in KiB with the IMAGE_ROOTFS_* variables, and content sizes for rawcopy files and boot files (table part/size). It returns every partition's start, size and end in the Layout table and text, the image size, free space, bitbake's ROOTFS_SIZE, and warnings for overlaps, raw bootloaders pushed off their ROM offset, rootfs larger than --fixed-size, options wic rejects, and misaligned partitions. Use it to size a .wks before building or to check why a wic image does not fit or boot.
sources: poky scarthgap 5.0 scripts/lib/wic/ksparser.py (sizetype, defaults 10M/1.3), partition.py (get_rootfs_size, prepare_rootfs), plugins/source/rawcopy.py, bootimg-efi.py, plugins/imager/direct.py (layout_partitions, MBR 1 / GPT 34 sectors)
poky meta/classes-recipe/image.bbclass get_rootfs_size(); bitbake.conf IMAGE_ROOTFS_SIZE ??= 65536, IMAGE_OVERHEAD_FACTOR ?= 1.3
meta-freescale imx-imx-boot-bootpart.wks.in (33K); i.MX8M Plus reference manual boot chapter (32K); Rockchip boot flow wiki (sector 64 / 16384)
JEDEC JESD84-B51 EXT_CSD HC_ERASE_GRP_SIZE; SD Physical Layer spec AU_SIZE
